title: CURIOSITY WITHOUT ABANDONING MYSELF
passages: My relationship reflections were becoming more specific. I wanted to understand what closeness meant to another person. What helped them feel safe. What made a difficult conversation possible.

I also wanted to notice whether that curiosity came back toward me. Could I be myself here? Were we choosing each other? Understanding someone else's experience didn't have to require losing track of my own. I was trying to make room for love and self-respect in the same conversation.

reflections.prompt: Is your curiosity being met with curiosity?
Write one question you would like to ask someone close to you. Then write one thing you would like them to be curious about in you.
Choose a calm moment to ask your question, if you want to. Leave room to listen and to express your own needs.
